description: Occupancy stored as 72 instead of 0.72 - the mistake hotel operators make most often, and the reason CC-MOD-HOSP-02 is an error rather than a warning. Note RevPAR still computes, to a number 100x too large; only the rule catches it. CC-MOD-HOSP-03 also fires, because the fixture's flag economics are over the threshold in every scenario derived from it.
